h:
几乎适合您屏幕的小型工作流程。
几周前我就有了这个工作流程设计的想法。通过利用子图的潜力，我们可以缩小工作流程。

我添加了 Painter Node 的工作流程，有助于增加动作。我没有做过很多测试，但你可以尝试一下。

工作流程包括：

  • GGUF/Native Safetensor 模型工作流程

  • 用于附加运动的 Painter 节点（运动幅度）（此节点的工作流程）

  • 圣人注意

  • 劳拉·斯塔克斯

  • 万纳格（CFG为1时加强负面提示)

  • 自动输入 FPS (基于帧插值和速度)

  • 后处理：

    1. 帧插值

    2. 带模型的升级器

    3. 框架修剪

    4. 手动调整 FPS (覆盖自动 fps 输入和速度调整)

    5. 视频锐化

    6. 保存最后一帧

    7. 帧选择

📲工作流程中的所有下载链接和指南。

上面发布的视频包括嵌入式工作流程。 （下载视频，拖入ComyfUI）
需要ComfyUI-视频帮助套件自定义节点 打开视频的工作流程。

🧩 安装 ComfyUI-GGUF 节点

⚠️似乎这个自定义节点没有出现在新版本ComfyUI的“管理扩展”管理器中。

⚠️请勿在 ComfyUI 运行时执行此操作。

转到您的 ComfyUI、自定义节点目录。
🗂️ ComfyUI\custom_nodes
Git 将 ComfyUI-GGUF 克隆到该目录中。
在目录中右键单击并选择“打开终端”

🖥️桌面版

输入：
1：

git 克隆 https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF

2：

“C:\你的\目录\ComfyUI\.venv\Scripts\activate.ps1”

3：

pip install --升级 gguf

🧳便携版

转到 ComfyUI“ComfyUI_windows_portable”文件夹（run_nvidia_gpu.bat 文件所在的位置）。
在目录中右键单击并选择“打开终端”
输入：
1：

git 克隆 https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-GGUF

2：

.\python_embeded\python.exe -s -m pip install -r .\ComfyUI\custom_nodes\ComfyUI-GGUF\requirements.txt

🧩 安装ComfyUI-PainterFLF2V（使用此节点的工作流程）

⚠️请勿在 ComfyUI 运行时执行此操作。

转到您的 ComfyUI、自定义节点目录。
🗂️ ComfyUI\custom_nodes
Git 将 ComfyUI-PainterFLF2V 克隆到该目录中。
在目录中右键单击并选择“打开终端”

输入：

git 克隆 https://github.com/princepainter/Comfyui-PainterFLF2V.git

🧩 工作流中的自定义节点：

- ComfyUI-GGUF（对于 GGUF 工作流程）
- rg三舒适
- ComfyUI-East-Use
- ComfyUI-KJNodes
- ComfyUI-视频帮助套件
- ComfyUI-必需品
- ComfyUI-帧插值
- ComfyUI-PainterFLF2V（仅限 Painter 工作流程）

o.en:
Small Workflow that almost fit into your screen.
I have this idea of this workflow design weeks ago. By utilizing the potential of Subgraphs, we can shrink the workflow smaller.

I have added a workflow with Painter Node which help to increase motion. I have not done many tests but you can experiment with it.

Workflow Includes:

  • GGUF/Native Safetensor Models workflows

  • Painter Node for Additional Motion (Motion Amplitude)(Workflow with this node)

  • Sage Attention

  • Lora Stackers

  • WanNAG (to strengthen negative prompt when CFG is 1)

  • Auto input for FPS (based on Frame Interpolation and speed)

  • Post Processing:

    1. Frame Interpolation

    2. Upscaler with Model

    3. Frame Trimming

    4. Manual Adjust FPS (overrides auto fps inputs and speed adjustment)

    5. Video Sharpening

    6. Save Last Frame

    7. Frame Select

📲All Download Links and Guide in the workflow.

Video posted above includes Embedded Workflow. (Download the video, drag into ComyfUI)
NeedComfyUI-VideoHelpSuitecustom node to open up workflow from video.

🧩 Installing ComfyUI-GGUF Node

⚠️Seems like this custom node does not show up in the "Manage Extension" manager in the new version of ComfyUI.

⚠️Do not do this with ComfyUI running.

Go to your ComfyUI, custom node directory.
🗂️ ComfyUI\custom_nodes
Git clone the ComfyUI-GGUF into the directory.
Right-click in the directory and select "Open Terminal"

🖥️Desktop Version

Enter:
1:

git clone https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF

2:

"C:\Your\Directory\ComfyUI\.venv\Scripts\activate.ps1"

3:

pip install --upgrade gguf

🧳Portable Version

Go to your ComfyUI, "ComfyUI_windows_portable" folder (where your run_nvidia_gpu.bat file is).
Right-click in the directory and select "Open Terminal"
Enter:
1:

git clone https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-GGUF

2:

.\python_embeded\python.exe -s -m pip install -r .\ComfyUI\custom_nodes\ComfyUI-GGUF\requirements.txt

🧩 Installing ComfyUI-PainterFLF2V (Workflow with this node)

⚠️Do not do this with ComfyUI running.

Go to your ComfyUI, custom node directory.
🗂️ ComfyUI\custom_nodes
Git clone the ComfyUI-PainterFLF2V into the directory.
Right-click in the directory and select "Open Terminal"

Enter:

git clone https://github.com/princepainter/Comfyui-PainterFLF2V.git

🧩 Custom Nodes in Workflow:

- ComfyUI-GGUF (For GGUF Workflow)
- rgthree-comfy
- ComfyUI-East-Use
- ComfyUI-KJNodes
- ComfyUI-VideoHelpSuite
- ComfyUI-essentials
- ComfyUI-Frame-Interpolation
- ComfyUI-PainterFLF2V (Painter Workflow only)
